name: Kitami Yuuma
source:
Yuuma is a young man who is an office worker. He is quite tired of his daily routine, which can only be reduced to work and the time it takes to get home from work. He starts to despair because he is tired of loneliness and wants to fall in love.

One snowy day in early January, Yuuma found an older girl in a maid uniform collapsed in front of his house. Her name was [url=/c77587]Eve[/url] and she told him that from that day she would be there to comfort him from the stress of daily life.
